title: format() rounds negative half values toward zero, asymmetric with positives (and yields '-1 seconds')
property_test: format sign symmetry at half boundaries
actual: '-1s'; long form gives '-1 seconds' (plural suffix chosen from |ms| >= 1.5*unit, but number rounded by Math.round to -1)
evidence: Math.round(-1.5) === -1 whereas Math.round(1.5) === 2; the plural() helper uses msAbs for pluralization, so it intends symmetric handling of negatives, yet yields ungrammatical '-1 seconds' vs '2 seconds' for the positive.
